refsection.title: Description
refsection.para:
The `SiikoStringSourceNew` calls `SiikoInputSourceNew` to create a `SiikoInputSource` that reads from a string.
* `InputString` is a string to read input characters from. `SiikoStringSourceNew` copies the string, so the InputString passed is still managed by the caller.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: If successful, `SiikoStringSourceNew` returns pointer to a new `SilikoInputSource` object returned by `SilikoInputSourceNew`. On failure, `SiikoStringSourceNew` retruns `NULL`.
